import type { FileUploadContract, FileRecord } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type NativeContract } from '../../internal/catalog';
export type FileUploadProps = NativeContract<FileUploadContract> & {
    variant?: 'button' | 'dropzone';
    description?: string;
};
/** Append one uploader's committed set once; preserve same-name successful siblings. */
export declare function appendCommittedFiles(data: FormData, name: string, files: readonly FileRecord[], disabled?: boolean): FormData;
export declare const FileUpload: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<FileUploadProps>;
